title: CKEditor 5 toolbar-configuration button contrast in light and dark mode
description: Replay the Full HTML toolbar-configuration fieldset and stop at the states where the reported contrast problem is visible: the page at rest, one toolbar item hovered with its tooltip, and one toolbar option focused. The scenario records the state and screenshots; the contrast ratio between the available-button background, the tray background and the button border is measured by a person or a contrast tool, because axe-core cannot decide it reliably for these controls.
preconditions: Standard install with Default Admin as default and admin theme, and the Full HTML text format with CKEditor 5.
No environment is registered for this issue yet; the intended pair is the !17909 merge request against a pristine Before.
Dark mode is Default Admin's dark-mode setting (appearance/settings/default_admin), not a scenario flag alone: set it to Dark or keep 'auto' with a dark OS scheme.

fixture.notes: No recipe is registered for #3637246 in this checkout (reports/issues/3637246/ contains only an intake brief). Plain Standard install is the intended starting state; the scenario will need a registered variant before it can be replayed.

steps.label: Open the Full HTML text-format configuration
Hover an active toolbar item so its tooltip appears
Put trusted keyboard focus on the Bold option without activating it
An icon-only toolbar item has keyboard focus
The focused element is a toolbar option

checkpoints.label: An icon-only toolbar item has keyboard focus

resetInstructions: No registered environment: build one first with node scripts/new-issue.mjs 3637246 --branch 3637246-ckeditor5-buttons-styling, then node tools/compare/setup.mjs 3637246-pinned.
Switch Default Admin's colour mode back to the starting value after each dark-mode pass.
manualReview: In light mode, measure the contrast between the available/active button background and the surrounding tray/page background, and between the button border and the background. The issue reports 1.25:1 and 1.16:1; these are target-size and non-text-contrast questions (SC 1.4.11), not text-contrast rules.
Repeat in dark mode and check that no light-mode white background survives on the button or the tray.
Check the same button at rest, on hover and on keyboard focus, because the reported problem changes with state.
Confirm that the focus indicator on a toolbar option remains visible against the new colours.
limits: No variant is registered for #3637246, so this scenario cannot be replayed yet and no result exists. The intended pair is MR !17909 (head 5917a35e) against pristine Before.
The issue's contrast figures were reported by a person; this scenario does not restate them as measured values.
axe-core's color-contrast rule does not cover these icon-only controls reliably, so the automated checkpoints are evidence for a person, not a pass or fail.
The dark-mode setting itself is part of the fixture state and must be equal on both sides; capture it from the page, do not assume it.
